text: Ray-Ban's ultimate parent, EssilorLuxottica SA, trades on Euronext Paris (ticker EL). Per its 2025 Universal Registration Document, its largest shareholder is Delfin S.à r.l. with 32.42% of share capital (143,588,995 voting rights) as of 31 December 2025; the remainder is in employee schemes and free float, with no state shareholder identified.

source.name: EssilorLuxottica 2025 Universal Registration Document, Section 7.2.1 'Change in the Share Capital'
